newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World plans stake in Siu-Fung.
newsitem.headline: New World plans stake in Siu-Fung.

text.p: New World Development Co Ltd has proposed to take a majority stake in troubled Siu-Fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd, Douglas Chan, executive director of New World Development (China) Ltd, said on Monday.
"We are interested and we have teamed up with Companion Building Materials," he told Reuters. "We will hold the majority stake."
He declined to give further details.
A spokesperson for New World Development Group said New World Development (China) was discussing taking more than 50 percent of the ceramics and machinery manufacturer.

Siu-Fung Ceramics said last November it was having serious cashflow problems and was in discussions with its banks to identify immediate funding requirements and alternatives for restructuring its debt.
Chan said New World was interested in expanding its building materials business and had officially proposed to Siu-Fung's banks to take a stake in the company.
Shares in New World ended HK$1.10 higher at HK$42.50 on Monday, while Companion shares rose HK$0.01 to HK$0.66.
Trading in Siu-Fung shares has been suspended since last October.
